summary: Tested kalshi_demo mode on backend and frontend. Passed: (1) GET /api/meta returns mode 'kalshi_demo' with mock_trading false. (2) Quotes use price_source 'demo' and match the demo order book exactly. (3) Fill-or-kill orders go to demo-api.kalshi.co. Rejection codes are mapped (insufficient_balance, market_closed). An unfilled order returns 409 and the booking is deleted. (4) Landing page: the lead and example paragraphs are gone; the headline, How it works and Today's rain odds remain. (5) Maria's checkout shows 'Rain refund unavailable · No sellers on Kalshi right now' with the toggle disabled for Today, Tomorrow and Weekend. (6) The dashboard badge reads 'Orders on Kalshi demo'. BLOCKED: the requested end-to-end booking for Maria (Chicago, Today) could not be done because the Chicago demo book is EMPTY. The book only ever held 46 contracts at 1¢, not about 250. The main agent's 1-contract probe and 45-contract verification order (15:45–15:47 UTC, both executed) took all of them. Miami and NYC demo books are also empty, so none of the 3 real merchants can sell a refund right now. To still prove the real flow, I ran ONE UI booking on a temporary merchant, 'TEST_ABQ Demo Patio' (Albuquerque; the demo book has about 297 contracts at 54¢). Result: 'Booking confirmed', "You're covered: $10 back if it rains on Sunday, October 25th." and 'Hedged: 10 contracts @ 54¢ on Kalshi (Kalshi demo · filled)'. db.orders had mode kalshi_demo, status filled, kalshi_order_id 01a173c3-52d8-7e8e-985f-544d0da24077 and cost $5.57. The Kalshi demo order shows executed, and the demo balance went from $99.70 to $94.13. The booking showed on the dashboard as Covered. Cleaned up: the TEST guarantee, its order and the temporary merchant are deleted, and Maria is back to 41 guarantees. Fixed one backend bug in _place_real: a crash when the rejection body's error field is not an object.

critical.issue: Demo order books for all 3 real merchants' markets are empty: KXRAIN-26OCT25-CHI, -26OCT26-CHI, KXRAINWKND-26OCT24-CHI and the MIA/NYC markets. Every checkout quote for Maria shows 'No sellers on Kalshi right now'. The book only held 46 contracts at 1¢, and the main agent's probe plus verification order took all of them. Rainly cannot sell a refund to any real merchant until demo sellers return.

minor.issue: FIXED by T1. If the rejection body had a non-dict 'error' value, e.g. {"error": "fok not filled"}, the code raised AttributeError and not HedgeFailed. That returned a 500 and left an orphan guarantee, because create_guarantee only deletes the booking on HedgeFailed.

Only HedgeFailed deletes the guarantee. Any other exception in place_hedge (an unexpected Kalshi 201 body, a DB insert error) leaves an unhedged guarantee. Use a broader except that deletes the booking and re-raises, or returns 409/502.

The 'chance of rain' shown to customers is now the demo book ask, not the real market. Albuquerque shows 54% on demo versus 43% on production. Chicago's weekend shows 0% when the demo book is empty, versus 2% on production. Price from the demo book, but show the production yes_ask as the rain chance.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Chicago this weekend: 0% chance of rain' when the demo book has no sellers (yes_ask 0.0). Show 'odds not available', or use the production price. Reference: app/merchant/[id]/index.tsx:91
